rag_rationale: Model value is proven and the pipeline is built, but scaling is blocked on data and the January go-live has little float left.
headline: Model cuts forecast error from 38% to 27%, but data delays put January go-live and ~€1M benefit at risk.
progress: MLOps pipeline built and tested end-to-end on pilot data
Planner UI prototype reviewed with 6 planners
Explainability view added to backlog after planner feedback

risks.title: Full-range data blocked on data platform
risks.description: Supply chain history and SKU mapping from DAT-02 have slipped, so the model cannot scale beyond the pilot category.
risks.mitigation: Extend hand-curated mapping to 3 more categories (~45% of revenue); ask DAT-02 to prioritise the SKU mapping table.
risks.evidence: We cannot scale beyond the pilot category with the current hand-curated mapping file.

risks.title: Missing the S/S 2027 planning cycle
risks.description: If go-live misses mid-January, benefits wait for the A/W cycle, deferring about €1M of working-capital benefit.
risks.evidence: deferring most of the inventory benefit by ~6 months

risks.title: Planners distrust model forecasts
risks.description: Planners heavily override forecasts today and may ignore the model without explanations.
risks.mitigation: Explainability view, co-design sessions, Skills Academy champions.

risks.title: Data science capacity drops in December
risks.description: One of the two data scientists goes on leave during validation.
risks.evidence: One of two data scientists on parental leave from December.

dependencies.what: Supply chain history tables on the lakehouse
Product hierarchy / SKU mapping from the catalogue domain

asks: Steering group to prioritise the SKU mapping table within DAT-02's catalogue work
